children: NEAR Protocol and Ondo Finance have launched tokenized US stocks and ETFs, including NVDAon, TSLAon, AAPLon, SPYon and QQQon, tradeable on near.com. Users can buy these assets with crypto from more than 30 networks through a single account, bringing tokenized US equities exposure directly onchain.

Chain abstraction removes the usual friction of moving assets between networks, so holders on more than 30 chains can fund one account and trade the equity tokens without bridging first. For NEAR, the launch adds a real-world asset use case that depends on actual trading activity rather than announcement value. Adoption of the offering is now the main variable to watch.
